summary: Fresh Cash Finance system tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/21 pytest pass (2 skipped due to estimate-creation payload differences, not financing logic). Frontend: contractor dashboard /app/financing renders all 4 tiles + 5 pipeline chips + Applications/Rentals tabs + Calculator (with amortization) + New application modals; public /finance/:token 4-step wizard (Apply → Decision → Sign → Done) works correctly — excellent FICO yields 'You're approved!' with 6.99% APR / $154.36/mo / 36 months, matching backend math.

minor.issue: Could not auto-test end-to-end because pytest's estimate-create payload didn't match the live /api/estimates schema (skipped 2 tests). Direct logic was reviewed and appears correct (idempotent reuse via existing finance_applications lookup, 400 when items_total < $500). Recommend a unit test once estimate payload shape is documented.

issues: Date of Birth uses browser-native HTML5 date picker (input[type='date']) instead of a shadcn calendar component — inconsistent with the rest of the app which uses shadcn date pickers elsewhere. Cosmetic, not functional.

Form inputs (first_name, last_name, email, phone, dob, ssn4, monthly_income, monthly_obligations, fico_bucket select, employment select, consent checkbox) have no name attributes and no data-testid attributes. Testing has to rely on ordinal indices. Adding data-testid='finance-apply-first-name' etc. would harden tests.

Interactive buttons (Calculator, Rental, New application, Buy-down per-row) and pipeline chips lack data-testid attributes. Functional correctness verified via text selectors but testability is fragile.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to FinancingApply.jsx form inputs (apply-first-name, apply-last-name, apply-email, apply-phone, apply-dob, apply-ssn4, apply-fico, apply-income, apply-obligations, apply-employment, apply-consent, apply-submit) and to FinancingContractor.jsx action buttons (new-application-btn, calculator-btn, rental-btn, buydown-row-btn).
Consider replacing the native HTML5 date input on FinancingApply step 1 with a shadcn calendar component for visual consistency with the rest of the app.

Optional: tighten the public-view sanitization to also strip applicant.email/phone if Fresh Cash compliance later requires it (currently only ssn4/dob are stripped, score/bureau/notes/created_by also stripped — good).
critical_code_review_comments: fresh_cash_service.MockBureauAdapter is deterministic per fico_bucket+ssn4 hash with ±10 spread — good. Subprime bucket (590 base) lands at 580–600 which straddles the declined/subprime boundary; expected per agent-to-agent note.
financing.py public_view_application strips applicant.ssn4/applicant.dob/score/bureau/notes/created_by — solid PII hygiene.
financing.py admin_override_decision recomputes monthly_payment + total_finance_charge when amount/apr/term all present — verified via test_admin_override_decision.
financing.py disbursement auto-advance only fires when current status == 'signed' — correctly idempotent (won't re-fire on already-funded).

Public estimate-finance endpoint reuses existing application by estimate_id lookup (idempotent ✓). However, it does NOT scope by company_id during the existing lookup — low risk because estimate_id is a UUID, but consider {'estimate_id': est['id'], 'company_id': est['company_id']} for defense in depth.
fresh_cash_service.RealBureauAdapter is correctly env-gated and falls back to MockBureauAdapter via _get_adapter() — clean adapter pattern.
Buy-down endpoint enforces status=='decisioned' (cannot buy down post-sign) — correct.
FinancingApply.jsx form inputs lack name + data-testid attributes — see action items.

success_rate.backend: 100% on financing endpoints (19/19 active tests, 2 skipped for estimate payload)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (dashboard, calc modal, new-app modal, public apply→decision→sign wizard)
